text.jp: ……そう言ってもらえると嬉しい。
text.official_en: ...That is kind of you to say.
text.real_en: ...I'm glad to hear you say that.

text.jp:
あ、あの……。
シド、なんだよね。
text.official_en: Uh, umm... You’re Cid, right?

text.jp: ああ……。
text.official_en: Sure thing.
text.real_en: Yeah...

text.jp:
ああ……。
俺も常闇のことをちゃんと知りたいって思ってる。
text.official_en: Right... I’m sure we have more than a few interesting stories to share.
text.real_en: Yeah... I want to get to know you properly too, Veritas of the Dark.

text.jp:
ああ。
明日、アルケア平原で決戦とする。
text.official_en: Yes. Everything will be decided at the Alcare Plains tomorrow.
text.real_en: Yes. Tomorrow we'll fight our decisive battle on the Alcare Plains.

text.jp: ああ。そうだが……。
text.official_en: Yes, that is I.

text.jp: ああ。知っている。
text.official_en: ...Yes. I’m aware.

text.jp: あいつとは闘技大会の決勝で戦う予定だった。
text.official_en: We were both finalists in the grand tournament.
text.real_en: We were supposed to face each other in the tournament final.

text.jp: あなたが怒っているように見えたので……。
text.official_en: You looked as though you are upset with me.
text.real_en: You looked angry, so...

text.jp:
あの……。
ごめんなさい……。
text.official_en: You’ll have to forgive me...
text.real_en: Um... I'm sorry...

text.jp: あの門の先にあった最終決戦の地じゃな……。
text.official_en: ’Tis what lies beyond the gate—the site of the decisive battle.
text.real_en: The site of the final battle, beyond that gate...

text.jp:
あれ、知らなかった？
私の姉さんは光輝のヴェリアスよ。
text.official_en: Oh, didn’t you know? Lux is my sister.
text.real_en: Oh, didn't you know? Radiance Veritas is my older sister.

text.jp:
あんたが氷刃か。
よろしくな。
text.official_en: Hey, you must be Gelidus.
text.real_en: So you're Frost Blade Veritas. Good to meet you.

text.jp: いえ、その……。
text.official_en: No, you see...

text.jp:
いつか常闇と手合わせしてみるといい。
あいつの剣はすげえぜ。
text.official_en: I suggest you have a round or two with Umbra sometime. His own blade packs quite a punch.
text.real_en: You should spar with Veritas of the Dark sometime. He's an incredible swordsman.

text.jp:
いつも常闇と妹の心配ばかりして
光輝の姉さんは母親みたいだな。
text.official_en: Give it a rest, you overbearing mommy. You’re the same way with your sister.
text.real_en: Radiance Veritas, you’re like a mother, always worrying about Veritas of the Dark and your younger sister.

text.jp:
う、うるさいわね。
あなたに言われなくても
常闇の強さは私が一番わかってるんだから。
text.official_en: I-I know that—better than anyone. I don’t need to hear it from you.
text.real_en: Q-quiet! I know better than anyone how strong Veritas of the Dark is! You don't need to tell me!

text.jp:
うん。
そうだよ。
text.official_en: Yup, that’s me. Sakura, Veritas of the Bolt. Though I mostly go by Tonitus.
text.real_en: Yeah, that’s me.

text.jp:
うん。
アタシもちょっとシドと話してみたい。
text.official_en: Good idea. I want to speak with Cid here, too.

text.jp:
ええ。
妹は私と同じぐらい強い力を持ってるわ。
text.official_en: I do, and she is formidable. Her powers are on par with mine.

text.jp:
えっ……。
ってことは、君はサクラなのか？
text.official_en: Wait, that means... Sakura?
text.real_en: Wait... does that mean you're Sakura?

text.jp: お前たちが誰であろうとどうでもいい。
text.official_en: Whoever you are is of no concern to me.

text.jp: お前のことをもっとよく知りたいしな。
text.official_en: Especially since I rarely meet someone of your strength... I would like to know more about you.
text.real_en: And I’d like to get to know you better.

text.jp:
お前の佇まいだけでわかる。
その刀を使いこなしてるようだな。
text.official_en: You must be quite adept with it—I can tell by the way you carry yourself.

text.jp:
お前の刀……。
俺が鍛えた紫電に似ているな。
text.official_en: Your blade... It’s similar to one I forged myself—Shiden.

text.jp: ここがアルドールの拠点か。
text.official_en: So this is the Aldorian base.

text.jp:
ここは戦場です。
そんな態度を不快に思う人も
多いのではないかと……。
text.official_en: But here I am, on a battlefield. Many tend to find my lack of resolve...aggravating.
text.real_en: We’re on a battlefield. I worry that this attitude might make a lot of people uncomfortable...

text.jp: この刀に恥じないように、これからも精進していく。
text.official_en: I will continue to train diligently to do honor to this blade.

text.jp:
この時代の八盟傑たちを見て思ったんだ。
俺は戦っている相手のことを
なんにも知らなかったって。
text.official_en: Seeing the Sworn Eight of the past... I realized that I know absolutely nothing about <text style="italic">who</> they actually are.
text.real_en: Seeing the Sworn Eight of this era made me realize how little I knew about the people we've been fighting.

text.jp:
これって７００年前のことなんだろ。
それだけの時間があれば人も変わるさ。
text.official_en: Well, it’s been seven centuries. Anyone would change after that long.

text.jp:
さて、明日は決戦だ。
今日は休むとしよう。
text.official_en: Now, tomorrow is an important day. Let us all get some rest.
text.real_en: Well, tomorrow's the final battle. Let's rest for today.

text.jp: そう……。
text.official_en: I...see...

text.jp:
そうか。
ま、好きにするといいじゃろう。
text.official_en: I see. Well, do as you wish.

text.jp: その刃で己の実力を示すがいい。
text.official_en: There, you can raise your blade and show your true worth.
text.real_en: Show me what you can do with that blade.

text.jp: それなのに、姉さんは心配症でね。
text.official_en: But she worries too much...
text.real_en: But my sister's such a worrier.

text.jp: だから、この戦争であいつと決着をつけるしかないのだ。
text.official_en: Which is why I intend to fight her in this war instead.

text.jp: だから、せっかくのこの機会に話してみる。
text.official_en: So I’m going to try to get to know and understand them while I can.

text.jp:
だが、あいつがヘスに行ってしまったせいで、
俺が優勝してしまったのだ。
text.official_en: But before our bout, she defected to Hess—leaving me to be crowned as champion.

text.jp:
だが、乗り越えてみせるさ。
レインと二人で。
text.official_en: But together, Rain and I will surpass him.

text.jp:
だけど、危なっかしくてね。
ちょっと心配なのよ。
text.official_en: Although she can be quite reckless, which always has me worried.

text.jp:
ちょうどいい。
全員集まったようだな。
text.official_en: Perfect. Everyone is accounted for.

text.jp:
でも、大切にしてくれてると思うと
ちょっと嬉しいんだ。
私たちはたった二人の姉妹だからね。
text.official_en: Deep down, though, I’m happy she cares for me. We’re sisters, after all.
text.real_en: Still, it makes me a little happy to know she cares about me. After all, it’s just the two of us sisters.

text.jp: ということは……。
text.official_en: Which means...

text.jp: なぜ、謝るのですか。
text.official_en: What are you apologizing for?

text.jp: なぜそこまでこだわるんだ？
text.official_en: Why are you so set on fighting her?

text.jp:
なんだか……。
二人ともイメージと違うんだけど。
text.official_en: Huh... This is a complete 180 to how they are now...
text.real_en: Huh... Both of them are nothing like I imagined.

text.jp: なんだ？
text.official_en: What is it?

text.jp: ねえ、一つ聞いていい？
text.official_en: Can I ask you something?

text.jp:
はは。
常闇が簡単にやられるわけないだろ。
text.official_en: Ha! And yet the chances of him getting defeated on the road are slim to none.
text.real_en: Ha! There’s no way Veritas of the Dark would be defeated so easily.

text.jp:
もし、そいつを倒すことがあれば、
心臓は大切に回収してくれ。
俺が有効に活用しようと思う。
text.official_en: Should you manage to defeat him, please bring me his heart. But be careful with it—I plan to use it for something important.
text.real_en: If you defeat it, be sure to retrieve its heart carefully. I think I can put it to good use.

text.jp:
もちろんだ。
だからこそ、早く
この戦争を終わらせたいのだ。
text.official_en: Unquestionably. It is the very reason why we must put an end to this conflict swiftly.
text.real_en: Of course. That's why I want this war to end as soon as possible.

text.jp:
わ……。
ホントだ。
六盟傑じゃなくて８人いる。
text.official_en: Oh wow, he wasn’t kidding...there’s eight of them.
text.real_en: W-wow... There really are eight of them, not six.

text.jp:
わかった。
ならば同行してくれ。
text.official_en: I see. Very well, you are welcome to join us then.

text.jp: アルケア平原……
text.official_en: The Alcare Plains...

text.jp: ヘスの八賢者にはバブイルの巨人という者がいる。
text.official_en: Amongst the Eight Sages of Hess, there is one called the Giant of Babel.
text.real_en: One of the Eight Sages of Hess is a being called the Giant of Babel.

text.jp: ヘスの基地に設置されていた兵器は破壊した。
text.official_en: I’ve destroyed the weapon emplacements at the Hessian base.
text.real_en: I destroyed the weapons installed at the Hessian base.

text.jp: ワシらはどうする？
text.official_en: ’Twould seem we have some time on our hands.
text.real_en: What should we do?

text.jp: 仲間を助ける話はいいのか？
text.official_en: Did you not mention you had a friend to save?

text.jp: 光輝と王土……。
text.official_en: Lux—and Tellus...
text.real_en: Radiance and Sovereign Earth...

text.jp: 光輝には妹がいるんだな。
text.official_en: So you have a younger sister?

text.jp:
別に怒っていませんよ……。
どうしてそう見えたのですか？
text.official_en: Well, I’m not... What made you think I would be?
text.real_en: I'm not angry... What made me seem that way?

text.jp:
姉妹で八盟傑に入れるなんて
すごいことなんだよ。
text.official_en: You know, it’s a pretty amazing thing that both my older sister and I got inducted into the Sworn Eight.

text.jp:
常闇、俺たちも
最終決戦に同行させてくれないか？
text.official_en: Umbra. Would you allow us to join you in battle tomorrow?
text.real_en: Veritas of the Dark. Would you allow us to join you in battle tomorrow?

text.jp:
常闇、心配したわ。
いつまでも戻ってこないから。
text.official_en: Umbra, there you are. I was beginning to suspect that something might have gone awry, since you were gone for so long.
text.real_en: Veritas of the Dark, I was worried. You were gone so long.

text.jp: 常闇は……あのテントの中か。
text.official_en: Umbra must be in that tent.
text.real_en: Veritas of the Dark must be in that tent.

text.jp: 戦わずしての栄冠など俺の美学に反する。
text.official_en: I cannot call myself the victor without meeting her in battle. There is no honor in that.
text.real_en: A victory without a fight goes against my principles.

text.jp: 戦争では何が起きるかわからない。
text.official_en: War is unpredictable, after all.

text.jp:
最終決戦に加わることで
それが叶うかもしれないんだ。
text.official_en: I have a feeling joining your side will help us do that.

text.jp:
期待しているぞ。
レインとやら。
text.official_en: Rain, was it? I will be looking forward to witnessing your mettle.

text.jp:
確かに、迅雷の声……。
口調は若々しいが、完全にサクラちゃんだ。
text.official_en: You can tell by the way she speaks... She sounds much younger, but it’s definitely her.
text.real_en:
That's definitely Thunderclap's voice...
She sounds younger, but it's Sakura-chan.

text.jp:
私、戦うのが好きではなくて……。
それが態度に出てしまうようなのです。
text.official_en: I...despise fighting...as I imagine is quite apparent.
text.real_en: I don’t like fighting... I guess it shows in how I act.

text.jp:
私だってちゃんと戦えるのに
お前は未熟だ、荷が重いって言って
難しい任務から外そうとするの。
text.official_en: I’m pretty strong, but she says I’m too green and the responsibility’s too much for me to handle. Can you believe she tries to cut me out of the more difficult missions?
text.real_en: I can fight just fine, but she says I'm inexperienced and that the tougher missions are too much for me. She tries to keep me out of them.

text.jp: 空は好き？
text.official_en: Do you love the sky?
text.real_en: Do you like the sky?

text.jp:
空まで戦火に包まれるのは
見ていられんからな。
text.official_en: I will not suffer watching the flames of war embroil even the sky.
text.real_en: I can't bear to see even the sky engulfed in the flames of war.

text.jp:
紹介しよう。
劫火、天風、水華、光輝、王土、迅雷、氷刃。
俺を入れてパラデイアの八盟傑だ。
text.official_en: Allow me to introduce the Sworn Eight of Paladia: Ignis, Aether, Alluvion, Lux, Tellus, Tonitus, Gelidus, and of course, myself.
text.real_en: Let me introduce them: Inferno Veritas, Heavenly Wind Veritas, Water Bloom Veritas, Radiance Veritas, Sovereign Earth Veritas, Thunderclap Veritas, Frost Blade Veritas. Together with me, they are the Sworn Eight of Paladia.

text.jp:
言いたいことは一つ。
俺と魔人フィーナの戦いを邪魔するな。
それだけだ。
text.official_en: But I will say one thing: Do not interfere in my battle with Archwitch Fina.
text.real_en: But I will say one thing: Do not interfere in my battle with Dark Fina.

text.jp:
言葉は不要。
語らうのは戦場で。
text.official_en: Words are meaningless. The only thing that speaks to me is the battlefield.
text.real_en: No need for words. We'll talk on the battlefield.

text.jp: 誰が母親よ！
text.official_en: I am <text style="italic">not</> a mommy!
text.real_en: Who are you calling a mother?!

text.jp: 迅雷の姉さんって……。
text.official_en: By older sister, you mean...?
text.real_en: Thunderclap Veritas's older sister is...

text.jp:
過保護すぎるって言われるけど、
大切な家族を失いたくないもの。
text.official_en: I have been told I am overprotective, but I could not bear to lose such a dear family member.

text.jp:
（そうか……。
八盟傑から六盟傑になったのは
サクラみたいに抜けた人がいるからなんだな）
text.official_en: (Now I get it... The Sworn Eight became the Sworn Six after two of them left...)
text.real_en: (I see... So the Sworn Eight became the Sworn Six because people like Sakura left.)

text.jp: （サクラがずっとチョコボの姿でいた理由もわかったぞ）
text.official_en: (...and that also explains why Sakura chose to turn herself into a chocobo in here.)
text.real_en: (So that’s why Sakura stayed in her chocobo form all this time.)

text.jp: （サクラみたいに抜けたってことか……）
text.official_en: (Maybe he left like Sakura?)
text.real_en: (So he must have left, like Sakura...)

text.jp: （バブイルの心臓って、インビンシブルの動力源だったよな）
text.official_en: (Wasn’t the Heart of Babel the <text style="italic">Invincible</>’s power source?)

text.jp: （六盟傑の中に氷刃はいない）
text.official_en: (Gelidus isn’t with the Sworn Six...)
text.real_en: (Frost Blade Veritas isn't among the Sworn Six.)

text.jp:
（同じ人物がこっちにもいたら、
八盟傑も混乱して話をするどころじゃなくなるもんな）
text.official_en: (Can’t imagine the confusion it’d cause if the Sworn Eight realized that there’s another Sakura with us...)
text.real_en: (If there were two versions of the same person here, the Sworn Eight would be too confused to talk to us.)

text.jp:
（門の向こうに行くためには、
この世界のことをよく知る必要があるからな）
text.official_en: (Following Umbra is probably the best way to learn about this world—and to open that gate...)
text.real_en: (We need to learn more about this world to get beyond that gate.)
